title: Promotion kit of a work account
summary: Trabalho → Kit para divulgar, on a company account (ADR 0082, bipe-chat/bipe#258). A button for the company's site, a QR code and ready lines, all to https://bipe.chat/@<handle>, for the company's own channels.

handle.description: GET /v1/me/handle. None: bipe_public_profile_needs_handle and nothing else.

copyCode.effect: Copies bipe_business_kit_button_code with the link and bipe_business_kit_button_label. Shows bipe_app_copied.

sharePng.effect: Shares the QR code as a PNG, dark modules on white with a quiet zone of 4 modules. The web saves the file where the browser cannot share it.

shareSvg.effect: Shares the QR code as an SVG, with the same modules and quiet zone.

copyLine.effect: Copies one ready line with the link. Shows bipe_app_copied.

notes: No link goes inside another platform's chat (ADR 0082): the kit gives no share action to a chat, only code, files and lines to copy, and bipe_business_kit_rule says so.
The button is a plain link with an inline style. It needs no script, so it works on any site. The issue said HTML or JS: plain HTML is enough.
bipe_business_kit_button_code is one string, so all clients give the same code. It uses single quotes because Android resources drop double quotes.
The kit needs no API: the handle is the only data. Nothing is stored and nothing is logged.
